placements.why: Both expressions record a concrete infrastructure decision (database platform swap) rather than a product, opportunity, or proof-point theme. No strata category exists yet in this repo, and nothing in the empty existing structure covers organizational infrastructure/system decisions, so this is a NEW foundational strata mint with no parent to attach under.
placements.title: Infrastructure decisions recorded as organizational commitments
placements.frame: What technical infrastructure or system-level decision is being recorded here, and what organizational commitment does it represent going forward?

placements.title: quantified performance gain as migration rationale
placements.frame: Does the justification for switching database systems rest on measurable performance and cost claims, and does that evidentiary basis stay stable as the decision moves from spoken commitment to written record?
placements.why: src-1 and src-2 both carry the same directional content — a PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB migration justified by a quantified performance multiplier and a cost reduction, first as live first-person commitment ('We're switching...') and then as a distanced triadic summary. This passes the narrative grain test: the migration decision and its performance/cost justification is a subject future envelopes (status updates, post-migration retrospectives, cost audits) will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. The specific '10x' figure and 'Q3 2026' date are facts that evidence this theme, not leaves in their own right, so they are folded into supporting_segments rather than minted separately. No existing leaf or strata name covers infrastructure-migration justification, so this mints fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.
